parameters.name: synonym_set
parameters.description: The synonym set to use for the expansion.

schema.description:
The name of a synonym set. A synonym set groups entries, for example, by domain.
Terms must be unique within a set, so different sets can define the same term
differently. The API creates a set when you add its first entry. If you don't
specify a set, the API uses the `default` set.
schema.title: SynonymSetName
